text: Contoso weekly DC exit sync w/ Mark Ellison (IT Director) and Ishani Deshmukh (Infrastructure Mgr, she runs the cutovers day to day). 140 VMs leaving the Naperville data centre in 3 waves. Wave 1 is 32 VMs, non-prod plus the intranet, cutover Sat 21 Feb. Naperville lease ends 30 June and Mark has zero appetite to extend.

Northwind call w/ Anton Kovalenko (Head of Transport) and Gianna Benedetti (Harrisburg depot manager). Cold-chain pilot: temp + door sensors on 40 refrigerated trucks out of Harrisburg, alerts straight to dispatch. 6 weeks from Mon 9 Feb, $36k fixed fee. Harrisburg pays out about $38k a month in credits for warm deliveries, target is to cut that by 30%.

Tailspin intro call tmrw 11:00 with Lorraine Pettigrew, their CFO. First time I'm meeting her. Background: we run their contact centre platform plus 24x7 support, $31.8k/month, renews 21 April. Bettina Sorensen (Director of Customer Care) is our champion. What should I ask Lorraine to understand how she's thinking about the renewal?

Draft a short email to Ishani at Contoso: let's walk through the wave 1 runbook together Thu 5 Feb at 10:00, and can her network team send over the firewall change ticket numbers before the 21 Feb cutover.

Tailspin: Lorraine call went well. Big one: she wants all pricing quoted per quarter, never monthly, their budgets run quarterly. So today we're $95.4k a quarter. She'd go 3 years if support for the new Amazon Connect platform is bundled and the Q4 seasonal agents are covered. Shannon Mercer (procurement lead) runs the paperwork.

Northwind: email from Fatma Yilmaz (Vendor Manager). Our managed network contract (SD-WAN + depot Wi-Fi, 4 depots plus HQ, $22.4k/month) renews 18 May. She wants a 3-year proposal by Fri 20 Feb and is opening at 12% off. Also wants the Wi-Fi refreshed at Erie and Scranton.

Contoso: first proper meeting with Evangeline Rourke, their CFO. She owns the DC exit business case. If they're not out of Naperville by 30 June the lease rolls month to month at $62k. Her rule for anything we send her: open with the cost of doing nothing, then our ask. Otherwise she stops reading.

Tailspin: Bettina and Kelsey Monroe (IT Director) walked me through the Avaya to Amazon Connect move. 160 agents. Pilot with the warranty claims team (40 agents) from Mon 23 Feb, the other 120 in waves after that. Jan abandonment was 9.2% vs their 5% target. Kelsey wants a written status at 4pm Mountain every day of a cutover week, nothing in between unless it's a P1.

Draft a 45-min kickoff agenda for the Northwind cold-chain pilot, Fri 6 Feb at Harrisburg. Anton, Gianna, 2 of her dispatchers, our IoT lead. Scope (40 trucks), what an alert looks like and who acts on it, how we baseline the $38k/month in credits, weekly readouts, what happens at week 6.

Northwind: sensor supplier just told us the shipment slipped, now lands Wed 11 Feb. Install is about 4 days across 40 trucks, so the Mon 9 Feb start is gone. Realistic start is the week after. Kickoff tomorrow still goes ahead, Gianna is fine with it.

Contoso runbook review with Ishani done. Wave 2 = 58 VMs (claims apps) on Sat 11 Apr, wave 3 = 50 VMs (policy admin + data warehouse) on Sat 16 May. Leaves about 6 weeks of buffer before the lease ends. Our Naperville infra support contract ends 15 June, the other date to watch.
Tailspin: Bettina wants the monthly KPI pack to show abandonment by queue (warranty, orders, tech support) from the Feb pack on. Passed it to our WFM analyst, easy add.

Contoso: Niamh Cassidy (CISO) pinged me. Nothing production moves to Azure until there's an independent pen-test of the landing zone. Not in our SOW and Mark didn't know about it. Wave 1 is mostly non-prod but the intranet counts as prod, so this hits 21 Feb.

Northwind kickoff at Harrisburg done, good energy, the dispatchers get it. Anton doesn't want email updates: he wants 10 mins at his Monday 11:30 transport huddle, every week. Gianna runs the pilot readout with us Thursdays at 2pm.

Draft a note to Mark at Contoso flagging Niamh's pen-test requirement. Not in our SOW, and since the intranet in wave 1 counts as prod it could hit the 21 Feb cutover. Propose a CR to bring in a pen-test firm, roughly $18-20k. Friendly, not defensive.

Renewal kickoff with Shannon Mercer at Tailspin tmrw 2pm. We're at $95.4k/qtr, renews 21 April, Lorraine is open to 3 yrs if Connect support and the Q4 seasonal agents are in. What's my opening position and what should I hold back?
Contoso: Ishani's network team sent teh firewall tickets, 14 rule changes, all approved for the 21 Feb window. One less blocker, assuming the pen-test thing gets sorted.
Tailspin: Shannon wants 10% off for a 3-yr commitment, and the Q4 seasonal seats (60 extra agents, Oct-Dec) priced as a seperate option. Needs our proposal by Fri 27 Feb. I didn't commit to anything.

Tailspin: Bettina says 31% of their contacts are 'where is my order'. She wants self-service order tracking in the Connect IVR, but not before the migration is done. Logged it as a post-migration idea, no promises.

Northwind: sensors arrived this morning, install started on the first 10 trucks. Leah Morgan (Head of IT) needs our gateway security questionnaire back before anything connects to their TMS. Our IoT lead is on it, due Fri.

Contoso: Mark approved the pen-test CR, $18.5k incl. remediation time. He can sign CRs up to $25k himself, so no need to go up the chain. Only slot the pen-test firm has is 23-25 Feb, so wave 1 cutover moves from 21 Feb to Sat 7 Mar.

Northwind install update: 22 of 40 trucks fitted. 3 of them have old reefer units with no data port and need adapters at $140 each, Gianna approved on the spot. Questionnaire went to Leah's team this afternoon.

Northwind: Fatma says Samuel Osei (CFO) signs off the network renewal himself. Her tip: never show him a percentage without the dollar amount next to it, he hates doing the maths and sends things back.

Tailspin incident over the weekend, and it's on us. Our Salesforce integration created about 1,900 duplicate warranty cases from Sat 14 Feb. Bettina's team is spending this morning cleaning up. Fix is in, a dedupe check on the case ID. She wants the RCA by Wed 18 Feb.

Evangeline Rourke called re the Contoso slip. She wants a risk-share in writing: if the exit runs past 30 June because of delays on our side, we pay 50% of the lease extension. Wants our position before her investment review on Thu 26 Feb.

Draft the Northwind network renewal proposal for Fatma, Samuel will read it. 3-year term from 18 May, 5% off the $22.4k/month, Wi-Fi refresh at Erie included, Scranton quoted as an option. Samuel's rule: every percentage gets its dollar amount next to it.
Tailspin - when did Shannon say she needs our renewal proposal by? And Lorraine wanted pricing quarterly not monthly, right?
What does the Naperville lease cost per month if Contoso overruns, and who on their side signs CRs?

Draft the RCA cover note to Bettina for the Tailspin duplicate cases. Own it: our integration retried without a dedupe check, about 1,900 duplicates from Sat 14 Feb, fixed Monday, plus a new alert if case volume spikes. Offer a $4,500 credit on the March invoice for her team's clean-up time.
Northwind: Leah's team signed off the gateway questionnaire, TMS access granted for the pilot. All 40 trucks fitted. Pilot goes live tomorrow, Wed 18 Feb.
Tailspin news: Shannon Mercer is leaving, last day Fri 20 Feb. Derek Pham (Senior Buyer) takes over our renewal. He hasn't seen any of the history, so I'll need to brief him properly.

Call with our pricing desk tmrw on Evangeline's 50% risk-share ask for Contoso. Lease extension is $62k/month. What's a sensible counter? I'm thinking a percentage with a hard cap, only for delays we cause, and conditional on Contoso hitting its own dependencies.

Northwind cold-chain pilot started on Wed 18 Feb, all 40 trucks live by 11:00. First real alert at 13:40, a failing reefer unit on a dairy run, dispatch swapped the trailer before anything spoiled. Gianna is thrilled.

Pricing desk call done. For Contoso we can offer 25% of any lease extension, capped at $40k total, only for delays we cause, and only if Contoso turns firewall changes round in 5 working days and app owners sign off 48h before each wave.

Draft an intro email to Derek Pham at Tailspin. Who we are, what we run for them, $95.4k a quarter today, renewal 21 April, and where Shannon left it: 10% off asked for 3 yrs, Q4 seasonal seats as a separate option, proposal due 27 Feb. Offer a 30-min call early next week.

Draft the Contoso risk-share response to Evangeline for her 26 Feb review. Her rule, cost of doing nothing first: 3 months of overrun is $186k on the lease alone. Then our offer: 25% capped at $40k, our delays only, conditions on firewall changes and app owner sign-offs.

Tailspin pilot slipping. Kelsey says the Salesforce screen-pop failed UAT, agents get the wrong customer record on about 1 in 20 calls. Not going live like that. Pilot moves from Mon 23 Feb to Wed 4 Mar, warranty team still first.

Northwind: Fatma came back on the network renewal. She wants 10% off, not 5%, and the Wi-Fi refresh at both Erie and Scranton included. Says Samuel won't sign anything that looks like a straight rollover.

Anton's Northwind transport huddle at 11:30, I get 10 mins. Pilot live since Wed 18 Feb, 40 trucks, first saves already. Give me 4 short lines to say out loud, plus the one thing I need from his drivers this week.
First call with Derek Pham (Tailspin) at 2pm. Word is he's got a competitor quote. If he leads with price, how do I keep it on value without sounding defensive? Give me 4-5 lines I can actually say.

Tailspin: Derek has a competitor quote at $26.5k/month, no workforce management in it. Wants us to match or explain the gap in writing. Strictly numbers, didn't care about the migration at all. Proposal still due Fri 27 Feb.

Contoso: Mark Ellison is off on paternity leave from Mon 2 Mar for 6 weeks. Ishani Deshmukh is acting IT Director while he's out and takes over CR approvals. Good for us, she knows the migration better than anyone.

Prep my 15 mins at Evangeline's Contoso investment review, Thu 26 Feb. Cover: DC exit status (wave 1 now 7 Mar after the pen-test, waves 2 and 3 unchanged), the risk-share offer (25%, $40k cap), what we need from Contoso. Open with the cost of doing nothing, she'll expect it.

Northwind week 1 readout with Gianna: 14 temperature excursions caught, 9 loads saved, roughly $11k of product. Downside: door-open alerts are way too noisy, 300+ in the first week, drivers hate it. Threshold goes from 60 seconds to 3 minutes from tomorrow.

Contoso investment review done. Board is fine with the exit plan. Evangeline countered on the risk-share: 40% capped at $75k. Ishani backed us on the dependency conditions, so those stay. Need to go back to the pricing desk.
Tailspin: Kelsey's team fixed the screen-pop, UAT passed on the retest. Pilot Wed 4 Mar confirmed with the warranty team (40 agents). The other 120 agents go in 3 waves: 23 Mar, 6 Apr, 20 Apr.
remind me exactly what the pricing desk approved on the Contoso risk-share, and the conditions

Contoso: Niamh's pen-test findings are in. 2 highs (open mgmt ports on 2 jump hosts, one storage account with public access), our cloud architect fixed both the same day. She's signed off wave 1 for 7 Mar. Remediation stayed inside the $18.5k CR.

Draft my counter to Fatma on the Northwind network renewal: 8% off on the 3-year term, that's $1,792 off the $22.4k a month, so $20,608/month, with the Wi-Fi refresh at both Erie and Scranton done by end of June. Final offer, say it nicely. Samuel's rule on percentages applies.

Draft the reply to Derek on the $26.5k quote for Tailspin. Angle: theirs has no WFM and no Connect migration support, ours has both plus 24x7. Offer: 3-yr at $29.9k/month incl. Connect support, Q4 seasonal seats as an add-on at $6.6k/month for Oct-Dec. Lorraine Pettigrew will read it, so quarterly figures only.
Anton's Northwind huddle at 11:30. Remind me the Harrisburg credits baseline and the target %, want to quote it right.
Pricing desk on Contoso: we can go to 30% capped at $50k, conditions unchanged. That's the ceiling, anything beyond goes to my manager.

Tailspin: Lorraine joined Derek's call, good sign. They'll sign 3 yrs at $89.7k a quarter if the Q4 seasonal add-on comes down to $18k for the quarter ($6k/month). Derek wants the revised offer in writing.
Northwind: Fatma accepted the 8%, $20,608/month for 3 years from 18 May, Wi-Fi refresh at Erie and Scranton by end of June. Samuel signs this week. Done, finally.

Draft my reply to Evangeline on the Contoso risk-share: 30% of any lease extension, capped at $50k, our delays only, same dependency conditions. Cost of doing nothing first as always, $62k a month. Keep it short, it's a decision email.

Prep me for tomorrow with Samuel Osei on the Northwind rollout: 170 more trucks across Allentown, Scranton and Erie. Hardware $68k one-off, $11/truck/month for all 210, integration $65k. Pilot so far: 9 loads saved in week 1. Across all 4 depots, warm-delivery credits run about $140k/month. He'll want payback.

Tailspin pilot started on Wed 4 Mar as planned. 38 of 40 warranty agents live on Connect by mid-morning, 2 headset issues. Abandonment on the warranty queue 3.9% so far today. Our first 4pm status to Kelsey goes out later.

Samuel meeting done. He likes the Northwind numbers but wants payback under 12 months on paper, and says the $65k integration is too high, he wants $40k. Otherwise ready to go. Leah Morgan joined for 10 mins, fine on the tech side.

Contoso: Evangeline accepted. 30% risk-share capped at $50k, our delays only, dependency conditions as written. Julia Kerrigan (procurement) will paper it as a change to the SOW and wants our draft wording by Wed 11 Mar.
How many agents are on the Tailspin pilot vs the full migration, and what are the remaining wave dates? Bettina wants it restated for her leadership team.

Northwind week 2 readout: with the new door threshold the alert noise is down 80%, drivers are on board. Warm-delivery credits at Harrisburg running 19% below the Jan rate so far. Gianna wants it on every truck.
Contoso wave 1 go/no-go at 2pm with Ishani and Niamh, cutover tmrw (Sat 7 Mar), 32 VMs. Give me the go/no-go checklist I should walk them through, incl. rollback triggers.

Draft the revised Tailspin renewal offer to Derek, cc Lorraine. 3-yr at $29.9k/month incl. Connect support, Q4 seasonal add-on $6k/month Oct-Dec. Lorraine wants quarterly figures, so show it per quarter with Q4 including the add-on. Offer valid until 31 March.

Contoso wave 1 done over the weekend. 30 of 32 VMs live in Azure, 2 rolled back: the legacy claims reporting servers, a SQL 2012 dependency nobody had documented. They move into wave 2, now 60 VMs, still Sat 11 Apr. Ishani calm about it.
Pricing desk on the Northwind rollout: integration can come down to $48k if Samuel signs by 31 Mar. Not $40k. Hardware and the $11/truck stay as quoted.

Prep me for the Tailspin QBR Wed 11 Mar: Bettina, Kelsey, Derek, and Lorraine joins for the commercial part. Cover Feb KPIs (abandonment 8.6% overall, down from 9.2%, now split by queue), the duplicate-case RCA and credit, the Connect pilot (started on 4 March, warranty team live), wave dates, and the renewal offer. Derek will want to close it in the room.

Draft the Contoso wave 1 closure note to Ishani, cc Niamh: 30 of 32 live, 2 rolled back into wave 2 with a SQL 2019 upgrade first, wave 2 still 11 Apr, lessons learned (undocumented dependencies, longer smoke tests). Mark's on leave, don't cc him.

Draft the revised Northwind rollout offer to Samuel: integration $48k (was $65k) if signed by 31 Mar, hardware $68k, $11/truck/month for 210 trucks. Show the payback, he wants it under 12 months. Dollar amount next to every percentage. Don't cc Anton, I'll cover it at his Monday huddle.

Tailspin pilot week 1: warranty queue abandonment 4.4% vs 9.2% in Jan, AHT down 35 seconds thanks to the screen-pop. 2 short Connect blips, both under 5 mins. Bettina wants the orders team in the 23 Mar wave.
Contoso: sent Julia the risk-share wording for the SOW change, on time. She'll issue the PO for the $18.5k pen-test CR in the same batch. Signature expected next week.

Tailspin QBR done. Derek confirmed the 3-yr renewal at $29.9k/month + Q4 seasonal add-on at $6k/month. Contract goes to their legal, signature target Fri 3 Apr, well ahead of 21 April. Bettina asked for a quarterly Connect roadmap session, we'll do it free in year 1.

Northwind: Gianna Benedetti is promoted to Regional Operations Manager from 1 April, all 4 depots. Great for the rollout, she's definately our biggest fan. Harrisburg gets a new depot manager, not named yet. Also Leah says the production gateway review takes 4 weeks, so no rollout before 13 Apr.
Summarise where Contoso stands for Monday's account review with our delivery director: DC exit by wave, the risk-share terms, open items, and who's who while Mark is on leave. Short.

Northwind week 3 readout: Harrisburg warm-delivery credits now 27% below the Jan rate, close to the 30% target. 31 excursions caught since go-live. Samuel's office asked for the week 4 numbers before he signs the rollout.

Draft the Tailspin QBR follow-up to Bettina, Kelsey and Derek, cc Lorraine. Renewal terms as agreed, in quarterly figures for Lorraine, contract with their legal, signature target 3 Apr. Connect waves 23 Mar, 6 Apr, 20 Apr. Free quarterly roadmap session in year 1. Duplicate-case credit on the March invoice.
Contoso: Evangeline wants a quote to extend our Naperville infra support by one month past 15 June, as insurance in case wave 3 slips. Needs it by Fri 27 Mar. Ishani thinks we won't need it.
Tailspin: 23 Mar wave confirmed, 40 agents from the orders team, Kelsey's people on site all week. Pilot queue abandonment holding at 4.2% in week 2.

Anton's Northwind huddle Monday 11:30, last one before Samuel decides. Give me my 10 mins: week 3 at 27% below the Jan credits rate, 31 excursions caught, Gianna moving up on 1 April, rollout no earlier than 13 Apr because of Leah's review, integration at $48k if signed by 31 Mar.
